74253.commentary: (UDa) upasantasantacittassā'ti upasantam'eva hutvā santaṃ cittaṃ etassā'ti upasantasantacitto. samāpattiyā vikkhambhanena hi upasantakilesattā upasantacittaṃ na sabbathā upasantasantan'ti vuccati tassa upasamassa anaccantikabhāvato, na tathā aggamaggena. tena pana accantam'eva kilesānaṃ samucchinnattā arahato cittaṃ puna kilesānaṃ anupasametabbatāya samathavipassanā-heṭṭhima-maggehi upasantakilesaṃ hutvā accantasantabhāvato'va upasantasantan'ti vuccati. tena vuttaṃ, upasantam'eva hutvā santaṃ cittaṃ etassā'ti upasantasantacitto'ti.

examples.text: upasantasantacittassa, netticchinnassa bhikkhuno, vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro, mutto so mārabandhanā'ti.

examples.text: upasantasantacittassa, netticchinnassa bhikkhuno, vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro, mutto so mārabandhanāti.

examples.text: ye keci bhūtā bhavissanti ye vā'pi, sabbe gamissanti pahāya dehaṃ, taṃ sabbajāniṃ kusalo viditvā, ātāpiyo brahmacariyaṃ careyyā'ti.

74257.commentary: (UDa) tatiye rājagahe suppabuddho nāma kuṭṭhī ahosī'ti suppabuddhanāmako eko puriso rājagahe ahosi. so ca kuṭṭhī kuṭṭharogena bāḷhavidūsitagatto.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena rājagahe suppabuddho nāma kuṭṭhī ahosi, manussadaliddo, manussakapaṇo, manussavarāko.

74258.commentary: (UDa) kuṭṭhicīvarenā'ti kuṭṭhīnaṃ cīvarena. yebhuyyena hi kuṭṭhino ḍaṃsa-makasa-sarīsapa-paṭibāhan'atthaṃ rogapaṭicchādan'atthañ'ca yaṃ vā taṃ vā pilotikakhaṇḍaṃ gahetvā pārupati, evam'ayam'pī'ti dasseti. paṃsukūlacīvaradharattā vā aggaḷānaṃ anekavaṇṇabhāvena kuṭṭhasarīrasadiso'ti hīḷento kuṭṭhicīvarenā'ti āha.

examples.text: so uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto addasa tagarasikhiṃ paccekabuddhaṃ nagaraṃ piṇḍāya pavisantaṃ. disvān'assa etadahosi, kv'āyaṃ kuṭṭhī kuṭṭhicīvarena vicaratī'ti? niṭṭhubhitvā apasabyato karitvā pakkāmi.

74259.meaning1: rough road; unsuitable place; (comm) (or) fierce animals

examples.text: cakkhumā visamānī'va, vijjamāne parakkame, paṇḍito jīvalokasmiṃ, pāpāni parivajjayeti.

74260.grammar: pr, from na ativassati, neg, trans (+acc)
74260.meaning1: does not soak; does not drench
74260.construction:
na + ati + vassa + ti
na + ativassati
74260.commentary: (UDa) vivaṭaṃ n'ātivassatī'ti āpattiṃ āpanno taṃ appaṭicchādetvā vivaranto sabrahmacārīnaṃ pakāsento yathādhammaṃ yathāvinayaṃ paṭikaronto desento vuṭṭhahanto aññaṃ navaṃ āpattiṃ na āpajjati, ten'assa vivaṭaṃ puna āpattivassaṃ kilesavassaṃ na vassati.

examples.text: channam'ativassati, vivaṭaṃ n'ātivassati, tasmā channaṃ vivaretha, evaṃ taṃ n'ātivassatī'ti.

74261.meaning1: intention to become a monastic; determination to ordain

examples.text: iṅgha tvaṃ, soṇa, tatth'eva āgārikabhūto samāno buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ anuyuñja kālayuttaṃ ekabhattaṃ ekaseyyaṃ brahmacariyan'ti. atha kho soṇassa upāsakassa kuṭikaṇṇassa yo ahosi pabbajj'ābhisaṅkhāro so paṭipassambhi.

74262.commentary: (UDa) paṭipassambhī'ti indriyānaṃ aparipakkattā, saṃvegassa ca n'ātitikkhabhāvato vūpasami. kiñ'c'āpi paṭipassambhi, therena vuttavidhiṃ pana anutiṭṭhanto kālena kālaṃ theraṃ upasaṅkamitvā payirupāsanto dhammaṃ suṇāti. tassa vuttanayen'eva dutiyaṃ pabbajjāya cittaṃ uppajji, therassa ca ārocesi. dutiyam'pi thero paṭikkhipi.

examples.text: iṅgha tvaṃ, soṇa, tatth'eva āgārikabhūto samāno buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ anuyuñja kālayuttaṃ ekabhattaṃ ekaseyyaṃ brahmacariyan'ti. atha kho soṇassa upāsakassa kuṭikaṇṇassa yo ahosi pabbajj'ābhisaṅkhāro so paṭipassambhi.
abhedi kāyo nirodhi saññā, vedanā sītibhaviṃsu sabbā, vūpasamiṃsu saṅkhārā, viññāṇaṃ attham'āgamā'ti.

74264.meaning1: Avanti in the south of India
74264.commentary: (SNt) avanti-dakkhiṇāpathe'ti aññesu suttapadesu āgatattā āha avanti-dakkhiṇāpatha-saṅkhāte'ti. majjhimadesato hi dakkhiṇadisāya avantiraṭṭhaṃ. pavattayittha ettha laddhī'ti

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena avantidakkhiṇāpatho appabhikkhuko hoti. atha kho āyasmā mahākaccāno tiṇṇaṃ vassānaṃ accayena kicchena kasirena tato tato dasavaggaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātetvā āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ upasampādesi.

atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa sarabhaññapariyosāne abbhanumodi, sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu, suggahitāni te, bhikkhu, soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sumanasikatāni sūpadhāritāni, kalyāṇiyā'si vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā.

74266.commentary: (UDa) sakavediyā vā paravediyā vā'ti tā evaṃ vuttanayen'eva saka-attabhāve ārammaṇavasena paṭilabhitabbāya pavattiyā sakavediyā vā parassa attabhāve paṭilabhitabbāya buddho nu kho, no nu kho'ti-ādinā vā parasmiṃ padhāne uttame paṭilabhitabbāya pavattiyā paravediyā vā yā kāci kaṅkhā vicikicchā.

examples.text: yā kāci kaṅkhā idha vā huraṃ vā, sakavediyā vā paravediyā vā, ye jhāyino tā pajahanti sabbā, ātāpino brahmacariyaṃ carantā'ti.

74267.commentary: (UDa) sakavediyā vā paravediyā vā'ti tā evaṃ vuttanayen'eva saka-attabhāve ārammaṇavasena paṭilabhitabbāya pavattiyā sakavediyā vā parassa attabhāve paṭilabhitabbāya buddho nu kho, no nu kho'ti-ādinā vā parasmiṃ padhāne uttame paṭilabhitabbāya pavattiyā paravediyā vā yā kāci kaṅkhā vicikicchā.

examples.text: yā kāci kaṅkhā idha vā huraṃ vā, sakavediyā vā paravediyā vā, ye jhāyino tā pajahanti sabbā, ātāpino brahmacariyaṃ carantā'ti.

74269.meaning1: as if mocking; appearing to be jeering
74269.commentary: (UDa) sadhāyamānarūpā'ti uppaṇḍanajātikaṃ vacanaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ. aññesaṃ uppaṇḍentā sadhanti, tadatthavacanasīlā'ti attho. tass'āyaṃ vacan'attho, sadhanaṃ sadho, taṃ ācikkhantī'ti sadhayamānā'ti vattabbe dīghaṃ katvā sadhāyamānā'ti vuttaṃ. atha vā visesato sasedhe viya attānaṃ āvadantī'ti sadhāyamānā.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā māṇavakā bhagavato avidūre sadhāyamānarūpā atikkamanti.

74270.commentary: (DNt) uppaṇḍanakathan'ti avahasitabbatāyuttakathaṃ. (VISMa) taṃ pana avahasitvā vacanaṃ hotī'ti āha uppaṇḍanā'ti.

74271.meaning1: should be derided; should be mocked

74275.commentary: (UDa) sadhāyamānarūpā'ti uppaṇḍanajātikaṃ vacanaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ. aññesaṃ uppaṇḍentā sadhanti, tadatthavacanasīlā'ti attho. tass'āyaṃ vacan'attho, sadhanaṃ sadho, taṃ ācikkhantī'ti sadhayamānā'ti vattabbe dīghaṃ katvā sadhāyamānā'ti vuttaṃ. atha vā visesato sasedhe viya attānaṃ āvadantī'ti sadhāyamānā.

74276.grammar: prp of sadhāyati, deno of sadha, trans (+acc)
74276.meaning1: mocking; jeering; laughing at; making fun of
74276.commentary: (UDa) sadhāyamānarūpā'ti uppaṇḍanajātikaṃ vacanaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ. aññesaṃ uppaṇḍentā sadhanti, tadatthavacanasīlā'ti attho. tass'āyaṃ vacan'attho, sadhanaṃ sadho, taṃ ācikkhantī'ti sadhayamānā'ti vattabbe dīghaṃ katvā sadhāyamānā'ti vuttaṃ. atha vā visesato sasedhe viya attānaṃ āvadantī'ti sadhāyamānā.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ. tena kho pana samayena sambahulā māṇavakā bhagavato avidūre sadhāyamānarūpā atikkamanti.

74278.meaning1: (gram) the root saddhu (not a known root in any of the classical grammars)

74282.meaning1: become self-confident; attained self-assurance; reached self-reliance

examples.text: na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhū na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradappattā yogakhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipannā sāmīcippaṭipannā anudhammacārino

74283.commentary: (UDa) dhammena na vaṇiṃ care'ti dhan'ādiatthāya dhammaṃ na katheyya. yo hi dhan'ādihetu paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti, so dhammena vāṇijjaṃ karoti nāma, evaṃ dhammena taṃ na careyya. atha vā dhan'ādīnaṃ atthāya kosalarañño puriso viya ocarak'ādikammaṃ karonto parehi anāsaṅkanīyatāya pabbajjāliṅgasamādān'ādīni anutiṭṭhanto dhammena vāṇijjaṃ karoti nāma. yo'pi idha parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caranto'pi aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati, so'pi dhammena vāṇijjaṃ karoti nāma, evaṃ dhammena vāṇijjaṃ na care, na kareyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: na vāyameyya sabbattha, n'āññassa puriso siyā, n'āññaṃ nissāya jīveyya, dhammena na vaṇiṃ care'ti.

74284.meaning1: ascetics, Brahmans and wanderers belonging to various religious sects
74284.commentary: (UDa) catutthe nānātitthiya-samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-paribbājakā'ti ettha taranti etena saṃsār'oghan'ti titthaṃ, nibbānamaggo. idha pana viparītavipallāsavasena diṭṭhigatikehi tathā gahitadiṭṭhidassanaṃ titthan'ti adhippetaṃ. tasmiṃ sassat'ādinānākāre titthe niyuttā'ti nānātitthiyā, nagganigaṇṭh'ādisamaṇā c'eva kaṭhakalāp'ādibrāhmaṇā ca pokkharasāt'ādiparibbājakā ca samaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakā. nānātitthiyā ca te samaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakā cā'ti nānātitthiyasamaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakā.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā nānātitthiya-samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-paribbājakā sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti nānādiṭṭhikā nānākhantikā nānārucikā nānādiṭṭhinissayanissitā.

74285.meaning1: attached to a variety of grounds for views
74285.commentary: (UDa) nānādiṭṭhinissayanissitā'ti sassat'ādiparikappavasena nānāvidhaṃ diṭṭhiyā nissayaṃ vatthuṃ kāraṇaṃ, diṭṭhisaṅkhātam'eva vā nissayaṃ nissitā allīnā upagatā, taṃ anissajjitvā ṭhitā'ti attho. diṭṭhiyo'pi hi diṭṭhigatikānaṃ abhinivesākārānaṃ nissayā honti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā nānātitthiya-samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-paribbājakā sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti nānādiṭṭhikā nānākhantikā nānārucikā nānādiṭṭhinissayanissitā.

74286.meaning1: not of this kind; not of this type; not like this
74286.commentary: (UDa) n'ediso dhammo'ti na ediso dhammo, yathā tayā vuttaṃ asassato loko'ti, evaṃ sesapadehi'pi yojetabbaṃ.

examples.text: te bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivād'āpannā aññam'aññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti, ediso dhammo, n'ediso dhammo, n'ediso dhammo, ediso dhammo'ti.

74287.commentary: (UDa) muṭṭhīhi saṃsumbhiṃsū'ti muṭṭhiyo bandhitvā pahariṃsu, muṭṭhighātaṃ akaṃsu.

examples.text: te ediso hatthī, n'ediso hatthī, n'ediso hatthī, ediso hatthī'ti aññam'aññaṃ muṭṭhīhi saṃsumbhiṃsu. tena ca pana, bhikkhave, so rājā attamano ahosi.
te ediso hatthī, n'ediso hatthī, n'ediso hatthī, ediso hatthī'ti aññam'aññaṃ muṭṭhīhi saṃyujjhiṃsu. tena ca pana, bhikkhave, so rājā attamano ahosi.

74289.meaning1: engaged in I-making; engrossed in self-identification
74289.commentary: (UDa) ahaṅ'kārapasut'āyaṃ pajā'ti sayaṃkato attā ca loko cā'ti evaṃ vuttasayaṃkārasaṅkhātaṃ ahaṅ'kāraṃ tathāpavattaṃ diṭṭhiṃ pasutā anuyuttā ayaṃ pajā micch'ābhiniviṭṭho sattakāyo.

examples.text: ahaṅ'kārapasut'āyaṃ pajā, paraṃkār'ūpasaṃhitā, etadeke n'ābbhaññaṃsu, na naṃ sallan'ti addasuṃ.

74290.meaning1: concerned with another's deeds; (comm) connected with the creation of an almighty god
74290.commentary: (UDa) paraṃkār'ūpasaṃhitā'ti paro añño issar'ādiko sabbaṃ karotī'ti evaṃ pavatta-paraṃkāra-diṭṭhi-sannissitā tāya upasaṃhitā'ti paraṃkār'ūpasaṃhitā.

examples.text: ahaṅ'kārapasut'āyaṃ pajā, paraṃkār'ūpasaṃhitā, etadeke n'ābbhaññaṃsu, na naṃ sallan'ti addasuṃ.

74291.meaning1: possessed by pride; endowed with conceit
74291.commentary: (UDa) mān'upetā ayaṃ pajā'ti ayaṃ sabbā'pi diṭṭhigatikasaṅkhātā pajā sattakāyo mayhaṃ diṭṭhi sundarā, mayhaṃ ādāno sundaro'ti attano gāhassa saṃpaggahalakkhaṇena mānena upetā samannāgatā.

examples.text: mān'upetā ayaṃ pajā, mānaganthā mānavinibaddhā, diṭṭhīsu sārambhakathā, saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattatī'ti.

74292.meaning1: bound by pride; held captive by conceit
74292.commentary: (UDa) mānaganthā mānavinibaddhā'ti tato eva tena apar'āparaṃ uppajjamānena yathā taṃ diṭṭhiṃ na paṭinissajjati, evaṃ attano santānassa ganthitattā vinibaddhattā ca mānaganthā mānavinibaddhā.

examples.text: mān'upetā ayaṃ pajā, mānaganthā mānavinibaddhā, diṭṭhīsu sārambhakathā, saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattatī'ti.

74293.meaning1: fact of being bound; fact of being tied

74294.meaning1: bound by pride; held captive by conceit; bound by comparing
74294.commentary: (UDa) mānaganthā mānavinibaddhā'ti tato eva tena apar'āparaṃ uppajjamānena yathā taṃ diṭṭhiṃ na paṭinissajjati, evaṃ attano santānassa ganthitattā vinibaddhattā ca mānaganthā mānavinibaddhā.

examples.text: mān'upetā ayaṃ pajā, mānaganthā mānavinibandhā, diṭṭhīsu sārambhakathā, saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattatī'ti.

74295.meaning1: fact of being bound; fact of being tied fast; being held captive
74295.construction:
vi + ni + √badh + ta + tta
vinibaddha + tta
74295.commentary: (ANt) kāmarāgena abhiniviṭṭhattā'ti etena kāmarāgābhinivesahetū'ti imassa atthaṃ dīpeti, tathā vinibaddhattā'tiādīhi kāmarāga-vinibaddha-hetū'ti-ādīnaṃ. tato mukho'ti tadabhimukho. mānan'ti āḷhakādimānabhaṇḍaṃ. sesam'ettha uttānam'eva.

74296.meaning1: who has overcome the four bonds; who has transcended fourfold bondage
74296.commentary: (UDa) catuyog'ātigato'ti kāmayogo bhavayogo diṭṭhiyogo avijjāyogo'ti cattāro yoge yath'ārahaṃ catūhi'pi maggehi atikkamitvā gato.

examples.text: yassa vitakkā vidhūpitā, ajjhattaṃ suvikappitā asesā, taṃ saṅgam'aticca arūpasaññī, catuyog'ātigato na jātu m'etī'ti.

74297.meaning1: scattered with dust; strewn with dirt
74297.commentary: (UDa) ubhayam'etaṃ raj'ānukiṇṇan'ti etaṃ ubhayaṃ pattaṃ pattabbañca rāgarajādīhi anukiṇṇaṃ. sampatte hi vatthukāme anubhavanto rāgarajena vokiṇṇo hoti, tattha pana saṃkiliṭṭhacittassa phale āyatiṃ āpanne domanassuppattiyā dosarajena vokiṇṇo hoti, ubhay'atthā'pi moharajena vokiṇṇo hoti. kassa pan'etaṃ raj'ānukiṇṇan'ti āha (UDa) ubhayam'etaṃ raj'ānukiṇṇan'ti tadubhayaṃ dukkharaj'ānukiṇṇaṃ.

examples.text: yañ'ca pattaṃ yañ'ca pattabbaṃ, ubhayam'etaṃ raj'ānukiṇṇaṃ, āturass'ānusikkhato. ye ca sikkhāsārā sīlabbataṃ jīvitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ upaṭṭhānasārā, ayam'eko anto.

74298.meaning1: who takes precepts as the essence; who regards training rules as fundamental
74298.commentary: (UDa) ye ca sikkhāsārā'ti yehi yathāsamādinnaṃ sīlabbat'ādisaṅkhātaṃ sikkhaṃ sārato gahetvā iminā saṃsārasuddhī'ti kathitā.

examples.text: yañ'ca pattaṃ yañ'ca pattabbaṃ, ubhayam'etaṃ raj'ānukiṇṇaṃ, āturass'ānusikkhato. ye ca sikkhāsārā sīlabbataṃ jīvitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ upaṭṭhānasārā, ayam'eko anto. ye ca evaṃvādino, n'atthi kāmesu doso'ti, ayaṃ dutiyo anto.

74299.grammar: aor of na maññati, neg, intrans
74299.meaning1: did not think; did not consider; did not suppose; did not presume
74299.construction:
na + a + mañña + i
na + amaññi
74299.commentary: (UDa) tena ca n'āmaññiṃsū'ti tena antadvayapahānena mama idaṃ antadvayapahānaṃ, ahaṃ antadvayaṃ pahāsiṃ, iminā antadvayapahānena seyyo'ti-ādinā taṇhādiṭṭhimānamaññanāvasena na amaññiṃsu sabbamaññanānaṃ samma'd'eva pahīnattā. ettha ca aggaphale ṭhite ariyapuggale sandhāya tatra ca n'āhesuṃ, tena ca n'āmaññiṃsū'ti atītakālavasena ayaṃ desanā pavattā, maggakkhaṇe pana adhippete vattamānakālavasen'eva vattabbaṃ siyā.

examples.text: etete ubho ante anabhiññāya olīyanti eke, atidhāvanti eke. ye ca kho te abhiññāya tatra ca n'āhesuṃ, tena ca n'āmaññiṃsu, vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ n'atthi paññāpanāyā'ti.
